$comment: The committed falsifying inputs for INV-PACK-40. The invariant text names three distinct ways to break it, and each one gets a case here, because they fail in different files and a test that only covers the first would pass while the other two shipped. Consumed by tests/test_ledger_unit.py.
statement: Every pack declares `ledger_unit` (Mode-A morpheme for `ja`, lemma otherwise) exactly once in its manifest, and every token-counting consumer reads it - `length_filter`, the new-item budget, V1/V2 and the stored speaking tokens. Each pack also declares its own window and budget, and the validator reports mean content-words-per-sentence per pack.

cases.why: A manifest with no `ledger_unit` leaves every downstream consumer to guess, and each one guesses differently. The declaration is what makes V1 lemma-level rather than surface-level.
Declared 'exactly once' is the operative word. Two declarations is worse than none: every reader finds one of them and none of them disagree loudly.

This is the case that cannot be caught by inspecting a manifest, because the manifest is correct. A consumer that whitespace-splits or word-class-regexes its own tokens agrees with the ledger for Spanish function words and silently disagrees for every Spanish clitic and every Japanese compound - and V1 then passes over a ledger that means nothing. The gate is a grep over the tree, so the falsifier is source text.
cases.planted_source:
def length_filter(text: str) -> bool:
    return 3 <= len(text.split()) <= 12

cases.why: The second shape of the same bug, and the one that looks most like care: a Unicode-aware word regex is right for Spanish often enough to pass review and is meaningless for Japanese, which has no whitespace and whose ledger unit is a Mode-A morpheme.

The invariant's own falsifier, verbatim: 'one shared window yielding a `ja` lesson that teaches three content words inside its budget'. A Mode-A morpheme is a smaller unit than a lemma, so a single global budget tuned on Spanish spends itself on Japanese bound morphemes and the lesson teaches almost nothing. Each pack declares its own.
cases.expect_reason: seven Mode-A morphemes inside the shared budget of 7 teach three content words
